text: A day out from Vael. A town on the road in — market stalls, a well, ordinary people. And then the shouting starts, and the smoke, and the men with axes who did not come to trade.

speaker: Kai
text: Those are villagers. That's a kid. That's a kid and there is a man with an axe walking at the kid.

speaker: Envoy
text: Kai. We do not have the numbers. The plan is the road, not the—
Kai is already moving. The plan was never going to survive the kid.

speaker: Perrin
text: HA! You see that? Stranger just charged a raiding line by himself. That's either the bravest thing I've seen all year or the stupidest, and I have GOT to know which.

speaker: Serra
text: It's both. It's always both. Form on him before both gets him killed — lances, with me. Cover the well.

speaker: Corin
text: The one who charged — his brow. Did anyone else see his brow light up? ...No. Of course no one else saw. Fine. Later.

speaker: Kai
text: I don't know who any of you are, but if you're helping, help. If you're narrating, do it quieter.

speaker: Perrin
text: Oh, I like him. Emberwing, on me! Let's earn our dinner!
